title: Reactor Countdown
description: Create a WHILE loop that counts down from 5 to 1, logging each number.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "The reactor is in cooldown mode. It needs to count down from 5 to 1 before it's safe to restart. We'll use a WHILE loop to monitor this countdown."
story.context: WHILE loops execute as long as their condition evaluates to True. They're perfect for situations where you don't know the exact number of iterations in advance, or when you need to check a condition before each iteration.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Perfect! The reactor counted down safely. Notice how the WHILE loop checked the condition before each iteration. This is different from FOR loops, which iterate a predetermined number of times."

instructions: Create a test case named 'Reactor Countdown'
Create a variable ${counter} and set it to 5
Create a WHILE loop with condition: $counter > 0
- Decrement the counter by 1 (use Set Variable keyword: ${counter - 1})
hints: WHILE body must be indented (4 spaces recommended)
Use END to close the WHILE loop
Make sure the condition eventually becomes False to avoid infinite loops!
solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Reactor Countdown
    ${counter}=    Set Variable    5
    WHILE    ${counter} > 0
        Log    Countdown: ${counter}
        ${counter}=    Set Variable    ${counter - 1}
    END
    Log    Countdown complete!

theory.title: Exercise 3.1.1: Introduction to WHILE Loops
theory.content:
MENTOR-9 points at the ship's reactor display, showing a countdown timer.

"See that? We need to wait until the counter reaches zero. But we don't control the timer—we just monitor it. FOR loops won't work here because we don't know exactly when it'll finish. We need a WHILE loop."

What is a WHILE Loop?

A WHILE loop repeats a block of code as long as a condition remains true. Unlike FOR loops that iterate a specific number of times, WHILE loops continue until their condition becomes false.

Syntax:

WHILE    ${condition}
    # Code to repeat
    # ...
END

Key Differences from FOR Loops:

FOR LoopWHILE Loop
Fixed iterationsConditional iterations
FOR ${i} IN RANGE 10WHILE ${counter} < 10
Iterates over collectionChecks condition each time
Always finiteCan be infinite if condition never false

Example: Simple Countdown

*** Test Cases ***
Countdown Example
    ${count}=    Set Variable    3
    WHILE    ${count} > 0
        Log    T-minus ${count}
        ${count}=    Set Variable    ${count - 1}
    END
    Log    Liftoff!

Output:

T-minus 3
T-minus 2
T-minus 1
Liftoff!

⚠️ WHILE Loop Rules

  • Condition Check: Evaluated BEFORE each iteration
  • Must Close with END: Required to mark loop end
  • Indentation: Loop body must be indented (4 spaces standard)
  • Infinite Loop Risk: If condition never becomes False, loop runs forever!
  • Variables: Often use variables that change inside the loop

Common WHILE Loop Patterns

1. Counter-Based:

${counter}=    Set Variable    5
WHILE    ${counter} > 0
    Log    ${counter}
    ${counter}=    Set Variable    ${counter - 1}
END

2. Boolean Flag:

${done}=    Set Variable    False
WHILE    ${done} == False
    # Do something
    ${done}=    Set Variable    True  # Eventually set to True
END

3. Waiting for Condition:

WHILE    '${status}' != 'ready'
    ${status}=    Get System Status
    Sleep    1s
END

MENTOR-9: "Your turn. Create a countdown from 5 to 1 using a WHILE loop. This will teach you the basic pattern: check condition → execute body → modify variable → repeat."
